summary: Sends x/y/color laser point channels to supported DAC devices such as EtherDream, Helios, and ShowNET.
key_concepts: Sends laser points to supported EtherDream, Helios, and ShowNET laser devices for computer-generated laser shapes and effects.
Expected input/output channels are x, y, r, g, b, i, and optional user fields, with x/y in -1 to 1 and color/intensity in 0 to 1.
Blanking occurs when incoming RGB channels are all zero or when Red, Green, and Blue Scale are all zero.
Device Type determines EtherDream network targeting versus Helios or ShowNET auto-populating device menus.
EtherDream IP discovery may require EtherDream DAT, while Helios scanning should not run with active Helios device connections.
Queue Time and Queue Units control the laser point buffer drain time and may need reduction for sparse point output.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Connect and send points to the selected laser device

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Choose EtherDream, Helios, or ShowNET device type

key_params.name: localaddress
key_params.note: Local NIC/IP to bind for networked device IO

key_params.name: queueunits
key_params.note: Samples, frames, or seconds for queue time

common_gotchas: Laser hardware is physically dangerous; do not auto-enable live output without explicit safety review.
Expected input/output channels include x, y, r, g, b, i, and optional user fields; x/y range is -1 to 1 and color/intensity is 0 to 1.
Blanking occurs when incoming RGB channels are all zero or RGB scale parameters are all zero.
EtherDream requires network/IP discovery; official docs point to EtherDream DAT for discovery help.
Helios and ShowNET expose auto-populating menus for attached devices.
Some user fields are not supported by EtherDream, so planner-generated channel schemas should match selected device type.
